caption: The worked example as a confusion matrix: the left column holds videos the detector flagged as fake, the right column those it passed as real. The two highlighted cells are the errors — 50 real videos wrongly flagged (FPR = 50 ÷ 1,000 = 5%) and 100 fakes missed (FNR = 100 ÷ 1,000 = 10%), which leave precision at 900 ÷ 950 = 94.7%.

spec.title: Deepfake detector: 2,000 videos
spec.aria: A two-row confusion matrix for a deepfake detector on 1,000 real and 1,000 fake videos: 50 real videos flagged (FP), 950 real cleared (TN), 900 fakes caught (TP), 100 fakes missed (FN).
